verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents source map support for reversing JavaScript transformations (bugsnag-docs-11), and it ships an official CLI (bugsnag-docs-12, bugsnag-probe-4). However, the CLI evidence only describes creating builds to enrich releases, not uploading source maps. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the CLI uploads source maps, any bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/Rollup), a documented CI upload workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that production stack traces are de-minified.
